scope: Model/editor review after repairing the weekday word model and dechunking On Monday; not an independent human or learner test.

englishNaturalness.evidence: What day? / On Monday. is a natural short schedule exchange when the program is already established, and Monday? / Yes. works as a brief confirmation.

persianMeaningQuality.evidence: Persian instructions distinguish the day meaning from time and room information and explain on only in its bounded weekday use.

pedagogicalClarity.evidence: on and Monday are now independent target words while On Monday remains a productive composition, removing the earlier hidden-chunk inconsistency.

distractorQuality.evidence: Reading and response choices contrast day, time and room meanings without relying on formatting tricks.

dialoguePlausibility.evidence: Leo and Liam are coordinating the already-established library event, so the elliptical day question is locally motivated.

difficultyFit.evidence: Only one weekday and its day preposition are taught; additional weekdays are deferred.

repetitionUsefulness.evidence: Monday is taught independently, read on a program card, heard in dialogue and then recombined with on in hidden retrieval.

transferQuality.evidence: The schedule question-answer idea transfers from clock time to weekday while preserving separate word units instead of memorizing one phrase row.

overallCoherence.evidence: Word teaching, card reading, dialogue, selection and final retrieval all serve understanding and stating the program day.

learnerExperience.evidence: Static review only; the flow is short and clear, but real learner timing, speech recognition and delayed weekday retention remain untested.

limitations: No independent human or real learner test has been performed.
The Lesson establishes only Monday, not a general weekday inventory.
Final ElevenLabs prosody and delayed retention remain unmeasured.
resolvedFindings: Monday is now an independent word rather than existing only inside On Monday.
on is separately represented for the scored weekday response, matching the words-layer rule.
On Monday remains a construction instance and is not inserted as a fake vocabulary row.
